title: RelaySchema
description: ANet Relay API v1 models (backend/tools/export_schema.py; do not edit).

payload_kg.description: payload, kg; take-off weight is mass_kg + payload_kg

prop_damage.description: damage of one propeller 0..1 (thrust loss, vibration)

imu_noise.description: attitude, rate and acceleration noise multiplier

AirframeRef.description: The snapshot's view of a simulator airframe: preset and seed only, never the values (06 §4).
AirframeRef.title: AirframeRef

id.description: the peer's install id, 16 hex digits

ArenaShot.description: A bullet in flight: integrate from (p, v) at t0 with the shared 1/240 s integrator.

t0.description: backend wall clock at which p and v hold (same clock as Fleet.t)

ArenaShot.title: ArenaShot

ArenaVehicle.description: A remote simulator, converted into this terminal's local frame (ENU m, radians).

yaw.description: rad, compass heading in the local frame

ArenaVehicle.title: ArenaVehicle

yaw.description: rad, NED heading: 0 north, clockwise positive

origin.description: [x, y, z, heading_deg] of the course origin

rings.description: rings placed in the vehicle's position frame

FlightHealthView.description: Rolling diagnostics over the last few seconds (03 §5.9). Flight items need the aircraft airborne.
FlightHealthView.title: FlightHealthView

index.description: step being flown (equals count once done)

ProcedureBrief.description: The aircraft's bench procedure run, current or last (WP-B, 05 §4.4).

step.description: step id while the run is active

ProcedureBrief.title: ProcedureBrief

id.description: props_removed, motor_check, calibrate_gyro, arm_start, apply_param, paused, ...

confirm_word.description: word the answer must carry on this aircraft, if any

operator_only.description: only the operator (the Relay window) may answer

data.description: motor layout, motor, sensor, item to apply, blocking checks

ProgramRunView.description: The program deployed on an aircraft, running or last run (WP-1, 06 §2.6).

reason.description: why it is paused, stopped or faulted (a code)

fps.description: frames run in the last second (50 when healthy)

overruns.description: frames over the 2 ms soft budget

rates_ok.description: ATTITUDE reached 40 Hz after the rate request; null: not yet

log_seq.description: sequence of the newest log line (GET .../program/log?after=)

ProgramRunView.title: ProgramRunView

ProgramStateMachine.description: A program's ``StateMachine`` as the inspector shows it (WP-1, 06 §2.3).
ProgramStateMachine.title: ProgramStateMachine

c.description: centre [x east, y north, z up], m

yaw_deg.description: compass heading of the ring normal

SimAirframe.description: GET / PUT /sims/{vid}/airframe: the full values (operator or controller).

active.description: the defects act now (hover assist off)

hover_throttle.description: level hover throttle 0..1 out of ground effect at full battery; null: cannot lift

SimAirframe.title: SimAirframe

SimView.description: Simulator flight model (05 §5.2, WP-C); null on real aircraft.

hover_assist.description: altitude and position hold available; false: physical flight

turbulence.description: turbulence strength 0..1 (acts only with hover assist off)

SimView.title: SimView

id.description: increments with every skill started on this backend

frames.description: one row per t, in the order of fields

UiCommandMessage.description: Server -> window over the operator WebSocket.
UiCommandMessage.title: UiCommandMessage

UiState.description: What the Relay window currently shows (04 §3.1).
UiState.title: UiState

programs_allowed.description: real aircraft: the operator allowed programs (reset when the link drops)
